He had opened up a gap at 10 miles (82 min. 28 sec.), increased it still further at 15 miles ( 2 hr. 3 min. 38 sec.), but between 18—19 miles was caught by A.

Green has been busy on Continental travels lately and defeated the European champion and record-holder, Schwab, by a stride after a neck and neck struggle for the whole of the 27 kilos (about 16 miles). A fortnight later in company with A.

The usual conditions were in force and two men were allowed in each event from each club, no man being allowed to turn out twice in the evening. 18 points were allocated to the winner's club, 17 points to second, and so on, downwards, in each event. The first race was at five miles and Redman (Metropolitan W.C.) and A.
Ives, whose time was 10h. 24m. 3s., and A.
Glancing back to our Gazettes of ten years ago, we find much of interest. Our Open Walk of 1929 attracted 205 entrants (23 teams) and was won by A.
